newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel up with NYMEX, diffs near flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel up with NYMEX, diffs near flat.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices rallied sharply Monday as the NYMEX basis prices shot higher by the settlement.
Differentials for both U.S. Gulf and New York Harbor jet fuel showed little change on the day, although the June heating oil futures on the NYMEX gained 2.13 cents.
USG prompt 54-grade jet fuel was talked between about 0.70 and 0.85 cents under the June futures, though traders said they saw no barrels change hands.
NYH differentials for prompt 54-grade continued to hover near a 1.50 cent premium to the NYMEX.
